target.title: fix(plugins): wrap self-hosted discovery JSON parse in try/catch
target.body:
## Summary

Wrap JSON.parse in readSelfHostedDiscoveryJson in try/catch so malformed JSON from self-hosted provider discovery produces a descriptive error with the endpoint label instead of a raw SyntaxError crash.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: JSON.parse on untrusted network response body without error handling.

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Proof script output** (proof-provider-json-parse.mts):
```
=== Proof: self-hosted provider malformed discovery JSON ===

Response body: not valid json {

--- Before fix (bare JSON.parse) ---
Error: Unexpected token "o", "not valid json {" is not valid JSON
Result: raw SyntaxError — no endpoint context, hard to debug

--- After fix (try/catch with label) ---
Error: malformed-test discovery response is not valid JSON
Cause: Unexpected token "o", "not valid json {" is not valid JSON
Result: descriptive error with endpoint label — clear which provider failed

PASS: malformed discovery JSON now produces labeled error.
```

**Regression test**:
```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/provider-self-hosted-setup.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
```

New test "wraps malformed discovery JSON with a descriptive error" verifies malformed JSON is caught without crashing.

**What was not tested**: Live self-hosted provider returning malformed JSON.

## Risk

Low. Called only during provider setup/discovery with existing caller-side error handling.
